notes.title: Update Description on June 21
notes.content:
I have fixed several minor issues, allowing you to complete the game smoothly and enjoyably (no need to worry about bugs). 
Feel free to use the "Special Rooms" feature to resume your room from where you left off. If you have any other issues, please leave a message in the community.
